pages.text: $(item)Illyrium Ore$() is rarer and needs a diamond pickaxe. Refining it takes four steps:$(br2)$(li)$(l:machines/illyrium_crucible)Illyrium Crucible$(): ore and slag become a Dirty Illyrium Ingot.$(li)Crush it into Dirty Illyrium Dust.$(li)$(l:machines/illyrium_refinery)Illyrium Refinery$(): dust, water and a filter give Pure Illyrium Dust.$(li)Back in the Crucible: Pure Illyrium Dust and Tetrium Dust alloy into Illyrium Nuggets.
Nine nuggets make an ingot by hand. To forge Illyrium in the Combination Forge, fit the $(item)Illyrium Forge Upgrade$().
Filters wear out. Better filters refine far more dust before they are used up.
